subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

They decided to __hit the nail on the head__ with their solution.

options.text: find exactly the right answer or solution

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **find exactly the right answer or solution**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"hit the nail on the head"** means to find exactly the right answer or solution to a problem. (सही उत्तर या समाधान ढूंढना)

 
 
• **Example:** When she suggested a new marketing strategy, she really hit the nail on the head as sales increased significantly.
 
 
 
• **"Solution"** refers to a means of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation. (समाधान)
 
 
• **Example:** The team worked together to find a solution to the budget issue.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **find exactly the right answer or solution**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Make the wrong decision** (गलत निर्णय लेना): To choose an incorrect or inappropriate course of action.

 
 
• **Example:** He made the wrong decision by investing in a failing business.
 
 
 
• **Avoid the problem** (समस्या से बचना): To ignore or evade addressing an issue.
 
 
• **Example:** Instead of solving the dispute, they decided to avoid the problem entirely.
 
 
 
• **Guess the outcome** (परिणाम का अनुमान लगाना): To make an assumption about what might happen.
 
 
• **Example:** She tried to guess the outcome of the experiment before conducting it.
 
 

193:Tf1a,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
